svg.aria-label: Ways to generate unique IDs. Auto-increment in one database is simple and ordered but is a single point of failure. A random UUID version 4 needs no coordination but has no order, which scatters inserts across a B-tree index. Time-ordered IDs such as Snowflake, UUID version 7 or ULID put a timestamp first, then a machine or random part and a sequence number, so they are roughly sorted by creation time without coordination; but they are only as ordered as the clocks.

svg.text: time first: roughly sorted, no coordination, only as ordered as the clocks
